name: sigil
description: Framework declarativo para extensões do VSCode — o TypeScript é a fonte única de verdade, o manifesto é derivado.

scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w hello -w counter -w todos -w notes -w restbench -w pets
scripts.typecheck:examples: npm run typecheck -w hello -w counter -w todos -w notes -w restbench -w pets
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:examples && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build -w hello && node examples/hello/e2e/run.js
scripts.example:build: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/sigil.js build examples/hello
